bug_semantics: Picklescan classifies pickle GLOBAL references through an enumerated module/callable blocklist. The standard-library module `pty` was not listed in `_unsafe_globals`, so a pickle whose reducer imported and called `pty.spawn` with an attacker command was counted as at most Suspicious (or clean) rather than Dangerous. A victim who runs the scanner, sees no Dangerous finding, and then unpickles the file executes arbitrary commands (e.g., a spawned shell), yielding code execution in the loading process.
flaw_origin: The initial scanner implementation introduced the incomplete blocklist design in `src/picklescan/scanner.py`: only callables explicitly enumerated in `_suspicious_globals` (later renamed `_unsafe_globals`) were reported as dangerous, so every unlisted dangerous callable — including `pty.spawn` — passed the scan. The smallest commit that first wrote this match-only blocklist mechanism is the scanner-introduction commit c1d5abdcc740e0d08a0d12d015d08e1e6f29a67e ("Implement Pickle scanner", 2022-09-04); the `pty` omission is a direct instance of that design, and later refactors preserved it.

evidence: Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-hgrh-qx5j-jfwx (CVE-2025-71322) describes the `pty.spawn` blocklist bypass, CWE-693, affected picklescan < 0.0.33, and patched 0.0.33; the HeroCTF 2025 "Irreductible 2" challenge demonstrated the bypass path.

Fix commit 70c1c6c31beb6baaf52c8db1b6c3c0e84a6f9dab (PR #53, "Fix various vulnerabilities") adds line 159 `"pty": "*",  # pty.spawn() allows executing arbitrary commands` to `_unsafe_globals` in src/picklescan/scanner.py; its parent d3273f4225da08c0998177a5ac0588724fa4bba0 contains no `pty` entry (git grep over the parent tree for `pty` in scanner.py matches only an unrelated _ZIP_SUFFIX comment), proving the sink absence pre-fix. Tag v0.0.33 resolves exactly to 70c1c6c31beb6baaf52c8db1b6c3c0e84a6f9dab, matching the advisory's first-patched boundary.

BIC: c1d5abdcc740e0d08a0d12d015d08e1e6f29a67e (2022-09-04, "Implement Pickle scanner") adds src/picklescan/scanner.py including the enumerated blocklist and match-only reporting; the direct parent 6a76b8c3ac67dc04181e600614ecf2a423cca326 predates the scanner (no src/ tree), so the blocklist mechanism is absent there.
